reviews.decision_reason: The selection step preserves all supplied demand records, including both fallback records, and reconstructs rows without changing record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, or source_weight. The package provides only structured corpus demand rows, so no independent market-demand corroboration can be judged here, but there is no localized transformation fault in this boundary.

The normalization step retains only the allowed explicit record identifiers, applies the bounded eight-row window, normalizes numeric fields, and preserves all eight supplied records needed for downstream handoff. No contradictory or missing transformation evidence is visible in the supplied package.

The provenance assembly step deterministically ranks normalized records by descending demand_score with record_id tie-breaks and emits the expected evidence_sources handoff. This ranking supports the downstream deterministic recommendation when paired with the supplied capabilities.
